karma.title: Karma and activity preferences
karma.explanation: Karma combines ranked preferences with assigned player seats. Drop-in activities do not affect it. Karma is one input to planning; it does not guarantee a place.
karma.grouped: Points apply to each group, including its cap. Assignments do not replace preference points.
karma.noContributions: No counted preferences or player seats.
karma.preferenceHelp: Player priorities run from 1 to 4. A game-master preference normally uses 0. Preferences and assigned seats are managed separately. Select an active schedule to save a preference; cancelled occurrences retain their existing records.
karma.removeConfirm: Remove this preference? Assigned seats will stay in place.

reasons.NonTimeExclusive: Drop-in activity; it is not time-exclusive.
reasons.UnrankedPlayerSignup: This player preference has no recorded priority.
reasons.GameMasterAssignment: Game-master seats do not add assignment points.
reasons.UnknownSignupRole: Unrecognized legacy role; review this preference.
